title: The Daylily - Rooftop Patio, Steps to Dining
description:
✨ Rooftop skyline views, modern design, and spacious comfort make The Daylily the perfect Nashville getaway. This stylish 4-bedroom, 4-bath East Nashville home features a bright open-concept layout, a fully equipped kitchen, high-speed WiFi, and a rooftop patio designed for relaxing and gathering. Just minutes from downtown and Broadway, it's perfect for family vacations, group getaways, business travelers, and extended stays. 🌆

The space
What You’ll Love:
◆ Spacious Rooftop Patio with cozy seating, firepit, cornhole, & skyline views.
◆ Prime Location just steps from Five Points & a quick ride to Downtown & Broadway
◆ Stand alone home, no connecting walls
◆ All bedrooms have an ensuite bathroom
◆ Fully-equipped Modern Kitchen with sleek appliances & essentials.
◆ Smart TVs – Log into your favorite streaming apps or cast from your phone.
◆ Central Heating & AC for year-round comfort.
◆ High-Speed Wi-Fi & Dedicated Workspaces.
◆ Garage parking available for two standard-size vehicles, plus ample street parking.
◆ Dog Friendly - $150 pet fee for up to 2 dogs. No breed or weight restrictions!

Sleeping Arrangements:
First Floor: 
◆ Bedroom 1 - Queen bunk bed (2 Queen beds) and a Twin daybed + Ensuite Bathroom & Walk-in closet with twin rollaway bed. 
Second Floor (Main Living): 
◆ Bedroom 2 - King Bed + Ensuite Bathroom
Third Floor: 
◆ Bedroom 3 - King Bed + Ensuite Bathroom & Balcony 
◆ Bedroom 4 - Queen Bedroom + Ensuite Bathroom

Need more space? Check out our listing that combines The Daylily with the neighboring home, The Aster, for the ultimate group getaway!

About Hallson Hospitality

At Hallson Hospitality, we take pride in being a locally owned company, offering a portfolio of thoughtfully designed properties that adhere to the highest standards of comfort and quality. Our team of hospitality professionals is dedicated to creating seamless and unforgettable experiences for each guest.

From curated amenities to personalized service, we go the extra mile to ensure your stay is exceptional. If there’s anything we can do to enhance your visit, please don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here to make your time with us truly unforgettable. To further elevate your stay, we offer a variety of Experience Add-ons, including early check-ins and late check-outs, private chefs, in-home massages, in-home yoga sessions, and more.

Pilates: 
Just a short drive away in the Wedgewood-Houston neighborhood is SŌLR Pilates, Nashville’s infrared hot mat Pilates studio. Guests staying in our homes receive 20% off studio classes and priority booking for private group sessions, perfect for bachelorette groups, birthdays, or a relaxing wellness experience during your stay.

Thank you for considering The Daylily for your upcoming trip! Be sure to add it to your Wishlist by clicking the ♥ in the upper right-hand corner, so it’s easy to find again – whether for this trip or a future stay.

Guest access
Before your arrival, we’ll send you a detailed email with all the information you need to easily locate and access the home, ensuring a smooth check-in process. This email will include a unique digital door code, customized specifically for your stay, providing secure and convenient access. If you have any questions or need assistance at any time, don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here to make your stay as effortless and enjoyable as possible.

Other things to note
Please note: This home features three floors of interior living space, with the rooftop terrace located on the 4th floor. There are multiple flights of stairs throughout the home. The main living area and kitchen are located on the second floor, so guests should be comfortable navigating stairs during their stay.

This East Nashville neighborhood is evolving, with a mix of newly built homes as well as some charming older developments that reflect the vibrancy of the area. It’s a community on the rise, offering a unique blend of urban convenience and neighborhood charm.
